offering_description.value: Owns and leases senior housing and outpatient medical properties to national senior housing operators and healthcare provider tenants, earning rent under long-term leases.

quotes.quote: National Healthcare Properties offers a balanced platform focused on senior housing and outpatient medical assets, delivering disciplined growth and long-term value creation.

At National Healthcare Properties, we combine the discipline of an institutional investor with the agility and creativity of an entrepreneurial firm. As a diversified healthcare REIT, we specialize in both senior housing and outpatient medical assets—two complementary and attractive asset classes that uniquely position us to capitalize on the aging of America.

customer_segment.value: B2B: healthcare provider tenants and large national senior housing operators

quotes.quote: We pride ourselves on being both proactive and relational—partnering closely with creditworthy healthcare provider tenants and large national senior housing operators. We actively monitor our portfolio, identifying and addressing potential issues before they can escalate. By cultivating collaborative, long-term relationships, we ensure strong operational performance while supporting a high standard of care for the healthcare providers, patients and residents who rely on our properties.

At National Healthcare Properties, our success is fueled by our hands-on approach to asset management and the symbiotic relationship between complementary asset classes. High-quality outpatient medical facilities with creditworthy healthcare provider tenants generate consistent performance, while strong partnerships with top industry operators and our high-quality needs-based assets propel our growth in the thriving and supply-constrained senior housing market.

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: rent from long-term leases of senior housing and medical facilities

quotes.quote: Our approach is tenant-friendly yet rent-focused, structuring competitive deals while remaining focused on renewals and maximizing rental income. With long-term leases, a stable credit tenant base and high retention, this asset class delivers predictable, resilient returns.
